name: banco_unico
description: Servidor Express para um banco unico com Postgres, pgvector e busca baseada em tokens.

scripts.dev:db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres
scripts.dev:db:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop postgres
scripts.dev:db:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f postgres
